content: Oracle ALL_DEPENDENCIES view lists dependent/referenced object pairs for procedures, packages, functions, package bodies and triggers, usable to build a static dependency graph for migration ordering; conversion tools typically skip this dependency analysis, leaving 'what depends on what / in what order' unanswered; dynamic SQL creates invisible dependencies not captured by ALL_DEPENDENCIES, so static graphs must be supplemented with manual/regex-based scanning of dynamic SQL and DBMS_* calls.
